notes: Modified cash basis (governmental) with accrual enterprise funds; basis recorded as cash. Governmental amounts are the Total Governmental Funds column (p7 statement of revenues, expenditures and changes in fund balances; p5 balance sheet). Beginning_cash is the printed beginning fund balance 555,000 and ending_cash is ending fund balance 1,690,745 (equals total assets, all cash/CDs/county treasurer). Loan proceeds 1,500,000 are in debt_proceeds, not receipts; printed total revenues 3,200,709 includes them. Business-type from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p9), total column; net position rolls 1,991,326 + 534,542 - 385,623 = 2,140,245. Business-type receipts/disbursements totals computed because the statement prints operating and nonoperating pieces separately. Enterprise interfund transfers (Electric -2,892, Water +1,446, Sewer +1,446) net to 0 within enterprise funds. Transfer cross-check: General Fund budget shows transfers from other funds 200,000 but actual is none; no governmental transfers; due to/from 36,581 between Street and Debt Service is an interfund balance eliminated on p5, not a transfer. No hidden transfers found. Balance sheet (re-check 2026-10-28, user balance-sheet rule): governmental lines now come from the Balance Sheet - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p5, labels on p4), with fund balance by classification, because its total 1,690,745 equals the government-wide governmental activities total (p1); the eliminated due from/to other funds (0 in the total column) is omitted. Business-type lines stay from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1, accrual); totals are the p1 Total column (assets 4,223,502 = governmental 1,690,745 + business-type 2,532,757). Detail: General Fund recorded from the General Fund Departments combining schedule (pp15-16, by department, no budget); the General Fund budget schedule on p11 is not recorded to avoid double counting (its budget amounts are not captured). The Departments schedule's loan proceeds 1,500,000 is listed as other financing but printed within total revenues (includes). Street fund loan proceeds actual 0, budget 1,000,000. Nonmajor fund CW Johnson Trust has no activity. No enterprise-fund budget schedules are printed in this report; business-type lines come only from the proprietary statement (p9).
